def make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return n distinct ids, identical on every call with the same seed.

    The ids are seed, seed + 1, ..., seed + n - 1, in that order. The
    result depends only on n and seed, so no capabilities are needed.
    """
    pre n >= 0
    pre seed >= 0 and seed <= 1000000000
    pre n <= 1000000000
    post out.len() == n
    post {x for x in out}.len() == n
    ex make_ids(3, 10) == [10, 11, 12]
    ex make_ids(0, 5) == []
    ex make_ids(2, 0) == [0, 1]
    out: list[int] = []
    for i in range(n):
        out.append(seed + i)
    return out
